item.title: Show HN: Clank Cut – Let your coding agent make video walkthroughs
item.summary: Hi HN, I made a mac desktop app which your coding agent can connect to and use ur mac to do the recording instead, as well as edit the video, add background music, clone my voice, and publish it to a bucket so ur agent can just automatically make and rerecord tutorials. I've ran into this issue a bunch in the past where I've needed to record a bunch of tutorials on how my software or specific features I've made work (mainly for documentation), and I've constantly needed to re-record things bc of new features or new UI, which has taken so much time. You can go back and a quick run through and quick edits like you'd do in traditional recording tools its usage based pricing, tried to keep it as cheap as possible (its like ~$1 for a 2 minute recording). It just records webapps rn, will probably add desktop and mobile later thanks fellas Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49190847 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
